## Meet Charles.
Charles is running for the United States Senate to fight for a Kentucky that works for all of us. A place where everyone can thrive and dream big again. Kentucky needs a bold vision to address our deepest challenges. A fighter for Kentucky’s working people, Charles is committed to a vision of government that builds a better future for everyone, not just the wealthy.
Charles’s work builds upon Kentucky’s long history of standing up and fighting back against greedy industries and politicians. He stood with miners in Harlan County and social justice organizers from Pike to Jefferson to McCracken. He stands with the people of Kentucky, from the hood to the holler, and it’s why they stand with him.
## Kentucky, it's time for us to turn a new page.
I’m running for Senate because I see the urgency of this moment. I know what’s at stake, but I also know that together we can win. We can build a future that’s worthy of this state and the people who call it home. I know Kentucky is worth fighting for, and I’m proud to be in this fight alongside you.

With you on our team, we’re going to build a strong movement across the Commonwealth — uniting Kentuckians across race, religion, and class — to win.

May 19, 2022
## Charles Booker, Democratic Nominee For U.S. Senate, Issues Statement On Abortion Ruling
LOUISVILLE, Ky. – Following today’s ruling by U.S. District Judge Rebecca Grady Jennings, Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate Charles Booker released the following statement:
“On the heels of the leaked draft opinion by the U.S. Supreme Court and Oklahoma’s ominous abortion bill, today we learned that Kentuckians will still have access to abortion heath care. A woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions should not be eliminated or forced by anyone. Every Kentuckian deserves access to vital, life-saving healthcare. The egregious HB 3 says otherwise. The wave of big government attacks on women is another reminder that the GOP leadership is not for the people, do not care about the health of our families, and have no desire to uphold the Constitution. We still have work to do to prevent bills like HB3 from ever being introduced and threatening the lives of Kentuckians. In the U.S. Senate, I’ll work to eliminate threats to Roe v. Wade by codifying it into law. To ensure we protect the rights of Kentucky families, as Senator, I will vote to eliminate the filibuster, lead the charge to expand the Supreme Court, and commit to supporting Supreme Court Justices who will uphold our Constitution and fight for reproductive rights.”

pages.text:
May 26, 2022
## Charles Booker, Democratic Nominee For U.S. Senate, Issues Statement On President Biden’s Executive Order
LOUISVILLE, Ky. – Charles Booker, Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate, releases the following statement after President Biden signs a police reform executive order on the anniversary of George Floyd’s murder:
“May 25, 2022 marked two years since George Floyd was murdered. We stood together as a commonwealth and a country, calling for the type of accountability that would honor George Floyd, Breonna Taylor, and everyone who was denied justice. It is an absolute shame Senators like Mitch McConnell and Rand Paul have derailed progress and blocked the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act from becoming law. While they refused to act, I joined families across the country in calling for President Biden to lead with executive action. I commend President Biden for responding and signing an Executive Order focused on accountability and community safety. This is an important first step in our quest to root out structural racism, injustice and inequity that has allowed law enforcement to use deadly force on communities like my own for too long. Chokeholds and no-knock warrants should have never been legal. Shootings and constitutional violations at the hands of law enforcement should have never been a norm.
In the Senate I will vote to codify necessary legislation to end qualified immunity, address implicit bias and disparate treatment, and community-based alternatives that focus on holistic health and safety.”

pages.title: Democratic Nominee For U.S. Senate Charles Booker Issues Statement On Scotus’s Epa Ruling - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate
pages.text:
June 30, 2022
## Democratic Nominee For U.S. Senate Charles Booker Issues Statement On Scotus’s Epa Ruling
LOUISVILLE, Ky. – In response to the U.S. Supreme Court ruling in West Virginia v. Environmental Protection Agency, Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate Charles Booker released the following statement:
“The Supreme Court’s ruling is yet another devastating blow to not only its own legitimacy, but our collective pursuit of a free, just, and safe society. Climate chaos is very real, and this destructive ruling will only make it worse. As Kentuckians, we will be especially harmed by this shameful rollback. In many ways, Kentucky has been a ground zero for the ills and decline in the fossil fuel industry. From struggling crops, to crumbling infrastructure, health disparities, and environmental injustice, Kentuckians from the hood to the holler desperately need and deserve better. Our children deserve clean air. Our families deserve a sustainable economic future. As the next U.S. Senator for Kentucky, I will fight to create a government that not only mitigates and combats climate chaos, but also protects Kentuckians from environmental pollutants, lowers costs for families, creates good paying jobs, and protects our health. Mitch McConnell and Rand Paul packed the Supreme Court on behalf of big oil and corporate greed. When I am elected, I will work to end the filibuster, unpack Mitch and Rand’s court, clean their harmful mess, and secure a Kentucky New Deal to ensure a brighter future for our children.”

pages.title: Issues - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate 2026
pages.text:
## Kentucky deserves a new deal for all of us.
Kentuckians helped build this country. That was part of the deal. But for too long, Washington has been sending politicians to Kentucky to tell us what we need. To tell us they know better, to save us from a problem they created for us. We deserve better. We deserve a new deal. A Kentucky New Deal.
We need a bold vision that centers the people of Kentucky in a comprehensive plan to build lasting infrastructure, break down barriers to democracy, end generational poverty, uproot structural inequity, build new statewide coalitions, and redefine the political landscape in Kentucky to ensure victory in 2026 and beyond. It’s time we finally address the deep, lasting challenges that have crippled our Commonwealth, and use innovative, grassroots organizing to meet people where they are — mobilizing Kentuckians around the issues they care about, while catalyzing our common bonds toward the aim of bridging divides of race, class, culture, and geography.
CHANGE WE NEED RIGHT NOW
## Our focus is on the issues people are facing right now across Kentucky.
There is a common thread across Kentucky that binds us together – Kentuckians are sick and tired of having decisions made for us by corrupt politicians who do not care whether we live or die.
If we stand together, from the Hood to the Holler, and demand deeper investments in our people, industries, environment and infrastructure, we can not only remove shameful politicians from office, we can win Kentucky’s future.
## 40 for 40 for 45
Charles knows the value of work. And so do Kentuckians. And they’re tired of putting in a full work week and still struggling to get by. Charles is fighting for his 40x40x45 plan because he knows workers in Kentucky and across this country deserve a raise. Despite rising costs of living for everything from healthcare to housing to childcare to utilities, wages have stayed largely stagnant. Charles will be fighting to change that.
40x40x45 is a new deal for Kentucky and it’s simple: If you work 40 hours a week, you should be guaranteed a minimum 40 hours of paid sick leave and a minimum wage of $45,000/year. Charles would couple this with support of the Cost of Living Tax Exemption, w hich means that $45,000/year will be tax free.
This means more money in the pockets of hard working Kentuckians and all workers will have the dignity of paid sick leave.
This plan will be possible because Charles pairs it with support for a wealth tax , which will allow us to generate lost revenue by leveling the paying field between regular people and the ultra rich. He will also support legislation that equalizes the tax rates for capital gains and eliminates the loopholes that allow corporations and billionaires to pay fewer taxes than you do. Because wealth should be taxed the same as work. And when we are all contributing, we can build an economy based on basic fairness.
## Medicare for All
Healthcare is a human right.
Charles supports Medicare for All to create a healthcare system that provides quality, affordable healthcare to everyone. As a Type 1 Diabetic who has rationed his insulin because he could not afford his medication, Charles believes that no one should die because they don’t have money to pay for life-saving medication.
As a nation, we pay twice as much for our health care as any other industrialized nation. The current healthcare system is expensive, wasteful, and places profits over people. Every Kentuckian deserves quality healthcare no matter how much money they have in their pocket.
## AI & Big Tech
Charles is clear that the development of generative AI and the role it will play in the future of work is possibly the most significant issue facing working people. We are standing at the precipice of an economic revolution that has potential to reshape the labor market and our economy. We need to have plans now to ensure that people are protected. Workers can’t be an afterthought.
Without strong guardrails, AI will further concentrate wealth, undermine workers, and allow corporations to replace human judgment with unaccountable algorithms.
That’s why Charles has called for a moratorium on building data centers until regulations can be put in place to protect the environment, communities against rising costs and other harms, and workers against potential displacement due to these developments.
Beyond data centers, Charles is also backing a number of strong protections and regulations that will support workers including: .
- Ensure workers share in the wealth created by AI. We will create a public equity stake in AI development so the profits generated from human labor, creativity, and public investment are shared broadly through a dividend for working people.
- Protect workers from displacement and exploitation. We will prohibit companies from relying solely on AI to make hiring, firing, or disciplinary decisions and impose surcharges on corporations that conduct layoffs due to AI automation to fund worker protections and retraining.
- Guarantee economic security during technological change. We will establish a federal jobs guarantee with paid retraining, relocation support, and income protection for workers in industries transformed or displaced by AI.
- Put strong guardrails on the AI economy. We will enact strict environmental and labor protections for AI development, prevent rising utility and other costs related to development from being passed on to communities, strengthen intellectual property rights for human-created work used in AI systems, ensure organized labor has a seat at the table shaping the future of work, and protect states’ ability to implement AI safeguards.
To ensure these protections are more than promises on paper, the centerpiece of this plan is to call for a new federal enforcement agency: The Human Labor Protection Bureau (HLPB).
Modeled on the successful framework of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau , this independent agency would be tasked with affirmatively protecting workers from harmful displacement and disruption caused by artificial intelligence.
The Bureau would enforce the laws protecting workers’ rights in the emerging AI economy, monitor and investigate companies to ensure compliance, and operate as a mechanism for workers to report potential violations.
## General Strike
Throughout our history, strikes have been a powerful tool of working people to come together in solidarity and demand change. Charles knows the strength of our collective power and unified voice, and he believes now is the time to use it.
A general strike is when multiple workers across multiple industries collectively agree to shut down production simultaneously to send a message that the system can’t work without us, so it’s time the system works for us.
Charles believes we are in a dangerous moment as we slide swiftly toward authoritarianism. This president has trampled on the rule of law, unleashed a rogue agency to terrorize our communities, threatened to take over elections, and illegally initiated acts of war. We are past the point of needing to save American democracy. We need to restore it. And without an empowered opposition party, we need other mechanisms to make our voices heard and demand accountability and change. In a moment like this, the power of the people is undeniable, and Charles is ready to organize for a general strike.
## Gaza
Charles has been consistent and clear that the actions of the Israeli government against the Palestinian people in Gaza constitute a genocide. And right now, the U.S. is funding that genocide, despite it being against U.S. law to provide weapons for countless war crimes.
Charles shares the grief felt across the world over the loss of Palestinian and Israeli lives in this conflict. He unequivocally supports a free Palestine, the release of all hostages, and a real and lasting end to the violence that has plagued this region and claimed too many innocent lives.
## Housing
Housing is a human right. Charles is committed to bring much needed affordable housing to Kentucky. Charles will also work to pass a Tenant Bill of Rights that protects renters from unfair practices. He has signed the Tenant’s Union pledge and is committed to ensuring that the priorities of renters are priorities in our housing agenda.
As someone who has experienced homelessness firsthand, Charles understands the impact that housing insecurity has on an individual’s ability to lead a productive and dignified life.
Too many Kentuckians struggle to pay their rent or mortgage, which is in part due to a national housing shortage that is driving up prices across the country. We must create more affordable housing to meet this vital need, and develop policies that lower the cost of housing overall.
## Affordability
We are in the midst of an affordability crisis. With the rising costs of childcare, housing, healthcare, and food, many of us can’t comfortably afford to live in the state we love and raise our children, live healthy lives in safe and vibrant communities, have a place to call home, and put food on the table. We need to make life more affordable for everyone. Charles’ plan is simple: A good life we can all afford:
- Guarantee a pathway to financial freedom . We will pass a universal basic income so every American has the financial security and freedom to build their future.
- Make it possible to raise a family. We will pass universal childcare so the security of knowing your children are taken care of while you work isn’t a luxury..
- Make housing affordable and abundant . We will build more affordable housing, implement federal rent stabilization, strengthen tenant protections like just-cause eviction and the right to counsel, and make major investments to end homelessness. Because housing is a human right.
- Expand opportunity for the next generation. We will cancel student debt, make public colleges and universities tuition-free, and invest in high-speed rail and public transit so all communities are connected to jobs, education, and economic opportunity.
Expand and strengthen the power of unions. We will protect and expand the right to unionize and collective bargaining rights for workers and tenants and restore more power to the people.
## Universal Basic Income
Every Kentuckian deserves the financial freedom to make decisions in their lives and an equity stake in the economy that we as workers build.
## Right to Unionize
Charles believes strongly in the power of unions and will fight to strengthen and expand the right to unionize and collective bargaining rights.
## Infrastructure
Connecting the Commonwealth from corner to corner so all can live a gainful life no matter where they’re from.
## Reproductive Freedom and Access to Abortion
Healthcare is a human right and abortion is healthcare. In the Senate, Charles will be a champion for reproductive freedom and true bodily autonomy. He will fight to ensure that a right to abortion is fully protected and accessible to all people who need it regardless of income. He will work to restore abortion rights, repeal the Hyde amendment, ensure that abortion and contraceptive coverage are fully covered as a form of health coverage.
## LGBTQ Equality
All people have the right to live with equal rights, access, and dignity regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity, and as Senator, Charles will fight for federal protections for LGBTQ people and families against discrimination and harassment and work to reverse this administration’s harmful attacks on the community.
## Fully Funded Public Education
Full and equitable investment in our education system ensuring that all Kentucky’s children have the resources and opportunities to pursue their dreams
## Community Safety
Full and holistic investment in community safety, working together to create safer, healthier communities in every corner of this Commonwealth.
## Decriminalizing Poverty
Ensuring that no Kentuckian is punished simply for being in poverty and that all Kentuckians have the opportunity and resources to live a gainful life.
## Reparations
Restorative economics that directly account for our nation’s deepest ills and move us towards a more equitable future for all.
## Join our campaign.
With you on our team, we’re going to build a strong movement across the Commonwealth — uniting Kentuckians across race, religion, and class — to win.

pages.title: SALT Plan - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate 2026
pages.text:
OUR SALT PLAN
## Stop Agents’ Lawlessness and Terror Plan.
Right now in Kentucky, we’re dealing with a massive snowstorm, so this should feel familiar. When ice takes over the streets and makes it dangerous for people to leave their homes, we don’t shrug and accept it. We put down salt, and we watch it melt.
That’s exactly how I think about ICE. When a dangerous, lawless agency takes over our streets and makes it unsafe for families to live their lives, we don’t accept that either. We act.
I’m introducing my SALT Plan—Stop Agents’ Lawlessness and Terror—because ICE has become a rogue agency that operates without accountability and inflicts harm on our communities. It’s time to end that. We need to abolish ICE, hold abusers accountable, and replace cruelty with a humane system rooted in equality, dignity, and community safety.
Today, as people in Minnesota engage in a general strike to demand ICE leave their state, I’m standing with them. If elected to U.S. Senate, I will:
- Abolish ICE. Period.
- Give people harmed by ICE the power to sue
- Prosecute agents for their lawlessness and abuses
- Fully fund a comprehensive and humane immigration system
ELECT CHARLES BOOKER FOR U.S. SENATE
## It’s time to show what loving your neighbor looks like in Kentucky.
With you on our team, we’re going to build a strong movement across the Commonwealth — uniting Kentuckians across race, religion, and class — to win.
It’s time for a Working People’s Bill of Rights

pages.title: Stop the Musk Plan - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate 2026
pages.text:
STOP THE MUSK PLAN
## Elon Musk is trying to buy himself a U.S. Senator in Kentucky.
Elon is dumping millions of dollars into Nate Morris’ campaign, but Kentuckians won’t fall for it. We have been screwed over and sold out long enough. The Commonwealth is not for sale.
I’m sick of a political system bought and paid for by billionaires, and Kentuckians deserve leaders who answer to the people. That’s why I’m running – to unrig the system for working families and hold people like Elon Musk accountable.
This seat belongs to the people of Kentucky—not to billionaires trying to buy power. I’m running to make sure our government works for us.
## Root Out Corruption in Politics
Support legislation that would root out corruption in politics including putting an end to Citizens United, banning corporate PAC money, closing Super Pac loopholes, eliminating dark money by increasing donor transparency, and taking other critical steps to meaningfully get big money out of our political system and transfer the power back to the people.
## ELON MUSK Act
Support legislation like the ELON MUSK Act that would prevent another Special Government Employee from getting rich off federal contracts while working in the government.
## New Legislation
Introduce legislation to immediately terminate and ban all federal contracts with companies affiliated with Elon Musk for the remainder of the Trump administration, while calling for a full independent investigation into his conduct as a Special Government Employee, including conflicts of interest, misuse of taxpayer funds, unlawful access to sensitive personal data, and actions that jeopardized national security. Require full financial restitution to U.S. taxpayers for any unlawful benefit or security breach, and ensure accountability under federal ethics and criminal law.
## Fight Against AI-Fakes
Fight back against the chilling effect AI-generated intimate images have on the ability of everyday Americans, especially women, to fully participate in public life and our political system free from intimidation, harassment, and violence by banning the use of GROK and similar apps and tools in the U.S. unless they prohibit users from generating fake explicit images of people without their express written consent.
ELECT CHARLES BOOKER FOR U.S. SENATE
## It’s time to show what loving your neighbor looks like in Kentucky.
With you on our team, we’re going to build a strong movement across the Commonwealth — uniting Kentuckians across race, religion, and class — to win.

pages.title: Aging with Dignity - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Aging with Dignity
When the Federal Government enacted Social Security in 1935, it became one of the most consequential and successful programs to lift Americans out of poverty in our history. At its core is a fundamental belief shared by nearly all Americans: we all deserve to age with dignity, and not in abject poverty.
But for years, Social Security has been under attack in this country. Politicians like Rand Paul have been working to defund and privatize our most critical social safety net, which could force millions of seniors into poverty. As Senator, Charles will support the Social Security Expansion Act, and will protect, expand, and fund Social Security to ensure our children are secure for the future.

pages.title: Community Safety - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Community Safety
Charles believes that every community in our commonwealth deserves true community safety. We are reminded nearly every day of the failures that our current system produces – unarmed Black men and women shot by police, children caught in the crossfire of gun violence, mom and pop stores held up at gunpoint by a person who has only known poverty their entire lives.
To truly realize community safety, we must have leadership at the federal level that will provide the resources and ability to address the root causes of crime, and align policies and money with our hearts. This means we must stop criminalizing poverty and drug use. This means we must ensure families have financial freedom and security to pursue economic opportunities that don’t reinforce violent outcomes. This means that we must fully fund alternatives to policing when appropriate. As Senator, Charles will stand with the expanded Democratic majority to pass the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, end qualified immunity, ban no knock warrants, and lead for investments in the social determinants of health to address violence as a public health crisis.

pages.title: Cut costs for American Families - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate

## Cut costs for American Families
Families across Kentucky were already struggling to make ends meet, but with rising prices for food, gas, and other household expenses, it has become near impossible. Meanwhile, U.S. corporations are reporting record profits, using supply chain issues to manufacture artificially high prices that only hurt our families.
As U.S. Senator, Charles will be a strong consumer advocate, fighting price gouging and addressing the massive windfall profits that drive up costs. At the same time, he will focus on addressing our supply chain challenges so that American businesses can thrive without hurting our families.

pages.title: Decriminalizing Poverty - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Decriminalizing Poverty
Charles is laser-focused on reforming the criminal justice system to address the disparities that disproportionately criminalize and incarcerate poorer communities and people of color. With one of the highest incarceration rates in the world, Kentucky has long looked to our prisons as a means to deal with larger, systemic problems we’d rather not confront. As a result, we end up trapping people in an endless cycle of poverty and crime.
As Senator, Charles will support legislation to end cash bail, address racial bias in risk assessments, and lead on broader pretrial reform to ensure that Kentuckians have their constitutional rights protected. He will push for reforms that prevent unnecessary sentence extensions due to technical violations, and he supports automatic expungement upon completion of a sentence to keep previously-served criminal records from continuing to hold back people fighting to get back on their feet.
Charles fully supports and has been a champion for full legalization of cannabis. In addition to legalization, Charles is standing for Kentuckians to support commutation of sentences and expungement of records related to cannabis. To address the devastating generational impact of the war on drugs, Charles supports direct economic investment and entrepreneurial resources in communities disproportionately harmed to make sure they are not blocked out of new industries that come from legalization.
Charles also supports broader decriminalization of drug use, and increased treatment supports for people convicted of drug-related offenses. To make sure the goal of our justice system is to help people heal, and not profit from the prison industrial complex, Charles supports an end to private prisons.

pages.title: End Endless Wars and Invest at home - Charles Booker For U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## End Endless Wars and Invest at home
The U.S. must be a leader for humanity both here and globally. To do that, we must finally address the military industrial complex that fuels our never-ending conflicts across the globe, and keeps us from investing our tax dollars here at home. We have a responsibility as a nation to stand with our allies in diplomatic pursuits of peace, and avoid attempts to re-enter military conflict whenever possible.
The United States Constitution planly states that only Congress has the power to declare war, and yet for decades, we have seen Congressional authority sidestepped in favor of endless war. We must strengthen and reassert Congressional authority to authorize matters of war and military conflict
